issue.title: Bug: [sflow][XGS] linux_bcmgenl kernel module not installed or loaded

failure.body:
**Is it platform specific:** broadcom

**Importance or Severity:** High

**Description of the bug:**

`linux_bcmgenl` is a kernel module in the HSDK-GPL (sdklt) stack that creates `/proc/bcm/genl/psample/rate`. Starting with SAI 14.3, this proc file is used to configure per-port sflow sampling rates on XGS LTSW platforms. Without it, sflow is completely broken on those platforms — the PTF receives 0 samples.

The module is built by the sdklt Makefile (`bcmgenl` is in `KMODS`) but is never included in the `opennsl-modules.install` package manifest and never loaded by `opennsl-modules.init`.

The bug was introduced in #19327 (August 2024), which added `bcmgenl` to `KMODS` when upgrading XGS saibcm-modules to 10.1, but did not update `opennsl-modules.install` or `opennsl-modules.init`. Release branches 202505 and 202511 are unaffected as they use SAI 14.1, which configures sflow rates via a different mechanism that does not require bcmgenl.

**Steps to Reproduce:**

1. Boot a SONiC XGS LTSW device (TH5/TH6) using the latest master image (SAI 14.3+)
2. Either:
   - Run `tests/sflow/test_sflow.py`, or
   - Manually enable sflow and configure a sample rate, and observe the failure logs

**Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior:**

*Actual:* sflow sessions fail to configure; PTF receives 0 samples. `/proc/bcm/genl/psample/rate` does not exist. `lsmod | grep bcmgenl` returns nothing.

*Expected:* sflow samples are delivered to the collector. `/proc/bcm/genl/psample/rate` exists and is writable by SAI.

**Relevant log output:**

```
ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_PORT:_brcm_sai_port_proc_samplerate_set:23450 cannot open knet link sample proc
ERR swss#orchagent: :- sflowAddPort: Failed to set session f000000000c4a on port 1000000000002
ERR swss#orchagent: :- sflowDestroySession: Failed to destroy sample packet session with id f000000000c4a
ERR swss#orchagent: :- sflowUpdateRate: Failed to clean old session f000000000c4a with rate 800000
```

**Fix:** #26360

resolution.title: [sflow][XGS] install and load linux_bcmgenl kernel module
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

`linux_bcmgenl` creates `/proc/bcm/genl/psample/rate`, which SAI uses to configure per-port sflow sampling rates on XGS (non-DNX) platforms. Without it, sflow is completely broken — the PTF receives 0 samples.

The module is built by the sdklt Makefile (`bcmgenl` is in `KMODS`) but was missing from the `.install` manifest and never loaded by the init script.

Closes #26363

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

- `opennsl-modules.install`: added `sdklt/build/bcmgenl/linux_bcmgenl.ko` to the installed files
- `opennsl-modules.init`: added `modprobe linux_bcmgenl` after `linux_ngknetcb` in the load path, and `rmmod linux_bcmgenl` before `linux_ngknetcb` in the unload path

#### How to verify it

Build an XGS image and run `tests/sflow/test_sflow.py`. Confirm `/proc/bcm/genl/psample/rate` exists after boot and sflow samples are received.

#### Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)

The `bcmgenl` sdklt module does not exist in 202505 or 202511 — backport not applicable.

- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405

#### Description for the changelog

[sflow][XGS] install and load linux_bcmgenl kernel module so that per-port sflow sampling rates can be configured via SAI.
